title_original: 지방자치단체 전자인사관리시스템 구축ㆍ운영 등에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 5 (Installation, etc. of Local Personnel Policy Support System)
(1) The Minister of the Interior and Safety may install a local personnel policy support system to support personnel policies of local governments. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017>
(2) Matters necessary for installation and operation of the local personnel policy support system shall be prescribed by the Minister of the Interior and Safety after consultation with the heads of local governments and the chairpersons of local councils. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017; November 30, 2021>
